subject.title: [BUG] exec tool: aborted run wedges subsequent exec calls in same session (regression from PR #94412)

question: Should this issue be closed only after PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101910 proves the same-session exec wedge is fixed, or does it need a separate exec-specific repair?
rationale: The current source and new comments show overlapping liveness failures, but the open Track A fix has not yet proven the exact exec-after-abort symptom reported here.

options.title: Verify Through Track A
options.body: Treat PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101910 as the canonical candidate, but keep this issue open until it includes or is followed by live same-session exec proof.

options.title: Require Separate Exec Repair
options.body: If Track A proof does not cover the exec slot/tool-state path, keep this issue as a separate focused bug for exec abort cleanup.

options.title: Fold Into Broad Design Only
options.body: Track this only under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101863, accepting that the specific production repro remains unclosed until broader lifecycle work lands.

recommendation.title: Verify Through Track A
recommendation.body: Treat PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101910 as the canonical candidate, but keep this issue open until it includes or is followed by live same-session exec proof.
